title: Guarded Wrapper Preview Follow-On Contract
claim: The guarded next-gate wrapper intentionally returns clearance preview only unless applyPreviewFollowOn is true.
summary: Record the read-only implementation finding that forgepilot_apply_guarded_canary_next_gate accepts applyPreviewFollowOn?: boolean. At PREVIEW_CLEARANCE, the wrapper returns preview-only when applyPreviewFollowOn is absent or false. It invokes createOperatorLocalExecutionClearance only after a successful preview and applyPreviewFollowOn: true. The repeated-preview result in FP-MCP-339 was therefore caused by a missing follow-on confirmation argument, not by host blocking, approval failure, or raw-tool exposure.
boundaries: No wrapper invocation in this checkpoint.
observedResult: The guarded next-gate wrapper intentionally returns clearance preview only unless applyPreviewFollowOn is true.
